name: searchsdk-repository
description: Repository-level checks for searchSDK. Each of brand/, sdk/typescript/, bench/ and site/ is a standalone npm package with its own lockfile.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix brand ci && npm --prefix sdk/typescript ci && npm --prefix bench ci && npm --prefix site ci
scripts.check:registry: node sdk/typescript/scripts/sync-registry.mjs --check && python3 sdk/python/scripts/sync_registry.py --check && node scripts/readme-providers.mjs --check
scripts.check: npm run check:public && npm run check:registry && npm run check:brand && npm run check:typescript && npm run check:python && npm run check:bench && npm run check:site
